content:
I don’t have live internet access, so I can’t see the current weather in Berlin in real time.

To check it accurately right now, use one of:
- A weather site/app (e.g., weather.com, AccuWeather, Windy)
- A maps service (e.g., Google Maps → search “Berlin weather”)
- A voice assistant on your phone or smart speaker

If you tell me the current conditions you see (temperature, wind, etc.), I can help interpret them (what to wear, if rain is likely to continue, etc.).
